# ui-parity-sheet metrics — the index of the side-by-side sheets.
#
# Generated by android/tools/ui-parity-sheet.py. One row per iOS baseline state,
# in registry order. `ios_px` is the iOS PNG, `android_px` the Android parity
# capture, `dw`/`dh` their difference in pixels (positive = iOS larger), `dh_pt`
# the same height difference in the shared 3x frame's points.
#
# `scale` is the ONE factor both sides of that sheet were resampled by, so the
# two panels stay comparable and a height difference stays visible.
# `paired=no` means this revision has no Android capture for the state, so no
# sheet exists for it — it is a visible gap, not a silent omission.
# `source=device` is a Compose harness capture in the parity baseline directory;
# `source=adb` is a hand `adb screencap` for a device surface the harness cannot
# reach (the launcher). A sheet's frame comparison is exact either way; what an
# `adb` sheet cannot claim is that Android's own capture drifted, because that
# capture is not part of the page regression gate.
#
